paragraphs.en: Every era ends, I think, not with an explosion but with a cooling [[ember]], and no columnist can decree the [[fate]] of the age she happens to inhabit.

I still remember the morning whose largest [[headline]] stared up from the breakfast page; its phrasing seemed to [[imply]] that the country had chosen to [[leave]] its old self behind, as though a recurring [[nightmare]] had been ordered to [[pass]] and never return.
Editors measured the story by a familiar [[score]]: a luxury [[suite]] booked for the visiting envoy, a [[superb]] trade figure, and the hard [[glare]] of cameras on the courthouse steps.
Beyond the capital, [[superhigh]] rents and crowded express roads now [[test]] the patience of commuters, and a single scandal can [[undo]] a career built over decades.

What strikes the visitor is the [[vigor]] of the coastal cities and, in the older market towns, a quieter [[vigour]] of a kind once described by a [[well-known]] novelist: the stubborn loyalty of people who feel they [[belong]] to a particular valley.
A reservoir that once fed a [[cataract]] of white water now sits low; children who used to play [[cricket]] on the common read about a [[criminal]] gang and a fiscal [[crisis]] in the same bulletin.

Whether the dislocation is anyone's [[fault]] is harder to say; a faint [[gleam]] of prosperity is visible even in the gloomiest lanes, yet progress has rushed [[headlong]] into places that had [[no]] appetite for it.
To resist is [[not]] a realistic [[option]] for the young, who throw themselves into commerce with genuine [[passion]], hoping to [[reap]] rewards their parents never imagined.
Advertising teaches them that a pricier product is always [[superior]], that a sports [[superstar]] deserves their devotion, and even old [[superstition]] has been rebranded as content for the feeds.
Demographers called to [[testify]] before committees will [[undoubtedly]] confirm what every [[village]] elder already knows.

A [[well-meaning]] teacher sitting on a wooden [[bench]] outside the school can still [[catch]] the mood before anyone else: whether the [[crop]] will be sold, why the river's fish [[decrease]] year by year, which families stand in [[favor]] with the local committee and which have fallen out of [[favour]] since the last election.
From where she sits, one may [[glimpse]] the entire national argument in miniature.

It is [[impossible]] to discuss the district without hearing of the wartime [[massacre]], a wound that even the most [[noble]] rhetoric has failed to close; historians preserve the survivors' [[oral]] testimony against the slow erosion of the [[past]].
There is a sound [[reason]] to publish this record as a [[supplement]] to the school [[text]], along the lane where every mill [[wheel]] once turned at each familiar [[bend]] of the river.
Such material belongs to its own [[category]] of memory, civic rather than commercial.

Tourists still [[cross]] the old bridge at dawn, when a lone [[crow]] calls from the poplar and an [[eminent]] professor, visiting from the capital, admits that what she once used to [[fear]] most—homogenization across the [[globe]]—has arrived.
The [[heavy]] trucks never failed to [[impress]] her with their scale, yet she questioned the official [[position]] that every change was unambiguously [[positive]].
Even the [[mass-market]] billboards, she noted with a [[nod]], now advertised nostalgia itself.

At dusk the sky turned a soft [[orange]], and the national [[pastime]] in the square was to [[recall]] the day's gossip while fingers continued to [[search]] for bargains on phones that [[supply]] endless diversion and [[support]] a thousand small traders.

A revived [[textile]] workshop had begun to [[assemble]] garments for a brand as far away as [[Virginia]]; its manager, a former stable hand who could still [[whip]] a cart up a muddy lane, insisted that [[accessibility]] mattered more than prestige.

Such claims [[annoy]] the planners in the [[capital]], for whom the boundary between city and countryside continues to [[blur]]; a [[consulting]] firm, applying strict quantitative [[criteria]], recommended that every household receive a [[device]] capable of monitoring irrigation and that the village finally [[ditch]] its paper ledgers.
Notices arrived first by [[e-mail]] and again by [[email]] reminder, an accident of this anxious [[era]], while a desk [[fan]] stirred the humid air of the office.

Few residents could [[forget]] the afternoon an elderly [[granny]], detecting a [[hint]] of condescension in the officials' questions, demanded a formal [[investigation]] into missing subsidies; [[laziness]], she declared, was a luxury no poor family could afford.
Water, once a gift, had become a tradable [[commodity]], and the new [[mindset]] taught people to [[extract]] profit from the [[majestic]] mountains rather than reverence them.
Whatever [[nobility]] the landscape retained, it had a determined [[opponent]] in the balance sheet.

For the young, the city promised a more [[pleasurable]] life: they would [[probably]] attend a fashion show where a model hailed as the [[queen]] of the [[runway]] paraded gowns stitched from local silk.

Psychologists warn that such spectacles can inflate [[self-esteem]] only transiently; [[socially]] ambitious teenagers saved for a designer [[sticker]] on their phone case, a cheaply [[symbolic]] gesture.
Researching any of this properly is [[time-consuming]], yet one must [[try]], however [[unreasonable]] the deadline appears.

The gala opened with a [[voluntary]] chorus and a [[whopping]] donation from a tycoon whose every public [[act]] was choreographed; tables groaned with every [[cate]] the region could boast, chosen to [[complement]] the wines.

A replica [[crown]] sat under a glass [[dome]], and guards were ready to [[crush]] any disturbance, though the loudest [[emotion]] on display was the [[gloom]] of excluded residents watching from behind a [[hedge]].

Critics called the pageant [[improper]] in a time of austerity, arguing that [[leisure]] on such a scale belonged to a [[master]] of industry, not to a [[noisy]] minority; a single muddy [[patch]] behind the marquee flooded every [[season]].

To be [[sure]], the organizers had reasons to [[thank]] nobody but themselves when questions of [[unfairness]] arose, and the mayor was caught in a [[whirl]] of interviews from which not even the most [[active]] press officer could rescue him.
Standing [[beside]] the ruined bandstand, one understood that [[besides]] corruption a deeper [[cause]] was at work: the ancient compact between town and land.
A child began to [[cry]] over a dropped [[cucumber]] while her mother joined the strange [[cult]] of the new phone, whose screen began to [[glow]] at the [[height]] of every dinner.
Few gadgets genuinely [[improve]] fellowship or [[lend]] an evening the gravity of a genuine [[masterpiece]].

In [[order]] to make sense of the [[patchwork]] landscape, I sought out a retired diplomat who kept no [[secret]] about the recent [[surge]] of capital into the valley; his brother, a [[surgeon]], thought the hospital's new wing would [[surpass]] any clinic in the province.

The old [[theatre]] had reopened as a cinema, though locals still called it the [[theater]], and an [[unfashionable]] playwright, once a household name, would [[whisper]] that his [[bestseller]] had outlived him.
His [[best-seller]] on statecraft urged [[caution]]: a [[culture]] that cannot [[curb]] its appetites will imagine every [[cure]] is for sale.
What can a lone writer [[do]], when institutions are [[feeble]] and the ambitious [[go]] where the grants lead?
Readers still write for [[help]], describing an [[inability]] to focus for [[long]] on anything longer than a caption.

Technocrats promise [[mastery]] as though society were an [[organ]] to be tuned; the technology [[sector]] posts a trade [[surplus]] one quarter and, to nobody's [[surprise]], reports data [[theft]] the next.
An [[unfavorable]] exchange rate here, an [[unfavourable]] review there, and even a [[virtuoso]] of public relations cannot repair an [[ecosystem]] wounded by years of [[insincere]] promises.

The [[senate]] debated farm [[parity]] and a new import [[quota]] while a [[little]] clerk allowed himself a [[frown]], aware that the most [[self-serving]] argument tends to [[court]] applause rather than truth.

A free press can [[mirror]] such moments, and occasionally a reporter stumbles on a [[golden]] [[scoop]] that explains [[everything]] at once, provided she remembers that the story belongs, in the end, to the people whose lives it describes.
